caption: Page 22 of the 1914 Icazbalceta-descended edition of Motolinía's Historia de los indios, with the word "Teonanacatl" in italics.
alt: Printed Spanish page of text with the italicized word Teonanacatl appearing partway down, describing mushrooms the Indians call by that name.
credit: Internet Archive / Casa Editorial Bouret (1914 reprint of Motolinía, Historia de los indios de la Nueva España)
note: This is the actual page (leaf 69 of the scan, printed page 22) containing the sentence transcribed in the draft: "A estos hongos llaman en su lengua Teonanacatl, que quiere decir carne de Dios...". Located via the Internet Archive full-text search-inside API against item historiadelosind00moto.
